reports.title: Newell Brands Announces Third Quarter 2026 Results

guidance.heading: Outlook
section: The Company initiated its outlook for the fourth quarter and raised its full-year 2026 sales outlook, reflecting third-quarter performance and updated expectations for the fourth quarter. Higher sales expectations and additional cost containment are offsetting additional inflation, enabling the Company to maintain the midpoints of its full-year normalized operating margin and normalized EPS outlooks.

Net Sales | 1% to 3%
Core Sales | 1% to 3%
Normalized Operating Margin | 8.4% to 9.0%
Normalized EPS | $0.17 to $0.19
Updated Full-Year 2026 Outlook | Previous Full-Year 2026 Outlook
Net Sales | 2% to 3% | 1% to 2%
Core Sales | 1% to 2% | Flat to 1%
Normalized Operating Margin | 10.0% to 10.4% | 10.0% to 10.4%
Normalized EPS | $0.74 to $0.76 | $0.73 to $0.77

The Company revised its full-year 2026 operating cash flow outlook primarily due to two one-time non-operating items, the first of which relates to the previously announced termination of its non-qualified defined benefit plans. This transaction is expected to generate a net cash benefit of approximately $60 million, but the benefit payments are classified as operating cash outflows while the associated proceeds are classified as investing cash inflows. The accounting treatment lowers expected operating cash flows by approximately $85 million, including related cash taxes. The second item reflects lower than previously anticipated proceeds from receivables factoring as the Company reduces its reliance on these programs following its upsized bond refinancing. Based on these two items the Company has revised its full-year operating cash flow guidance to approximately $150 million.
